goal: Actually inspect, classify and measure a creator-published same-glyph revision and multi-glyph validation, not infer creative decisions from finished contours.
originator: Zheng Chuyang / Typotheque type design team
newly_confirmed_author_statements: When dozens of characters reuse a radical, designers can become blind to systematic radical imbalance: peer review is needed.
Original 口 component was deliberately made wider, but its effect multiplied across thousands of characters and required re-condensing.
The figure explicitly captions the proportion revision of the right-side 阝 radical.
Characters using 包 must adapt the component to positional context, rather than paste the same shape.
